text: さされると　どくに　おかされ　するどい　いたみが　はしる。

structure.en: you are overcome by poison, and

structure.jp: するどい　いたみが　はしる。
structure.en: a sharp pain shoots through you.

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever that happens, this always follows'. さされると = 'if you are stung'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending turns 'sting' around so that the thing is done to you. どくに　おかされ works the same way, with に showing what does it. さされる = 'be stung'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: おかされ　するどい　いたみが　はしる
patterns.explanation: In written style a verb can drop its て and still join on to the next part, meaning 'and'. おかされ　するどい　いたみが　はしる = 'you are overcome, and a sharp pain shoots through you'.
